Instead, the event's energy was driven by student organizations and young activists who led the workshops and open forum discussions, suggesting that the movement for digital rights is currently finding its most vocal leadership within the younger generation rather than among established political parties.", "summary": "The Pirate Party UK remained absent from key conference sessions while young activists dominated the discussions."}}
